interpretation_notes: Candidate existence does not imply correct pronunciation, affordable CPU inference, permission for all product uses, or integration.
Models were not downloaded or run; only public metadata/model-card text was read.
The same model may cover many entries; its weights are counted once, not multiplied by voice or language count.
MMS and OmniVoice weights have non-commercial conditions and were not automatically adopted.
No country or population is a substitute for language-specific resources.
Do not use a Northern Ndebele model as Southern Ndebele.
FLEURS can support research/evaluation for its languages but is not an off-the-shelf TTS checkpoint.
